revenueModel.text: The Company earns net interest income from interest on loans and investment securities, net of interest paid on deposits and borrowings, plus noninterest fee income from customers.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's primary source of revenue is net interest income, or the difference between interest income earned on loans and investment securities and interest expense paid on interest-bearing deposits and other borrowings.
